title: Hypothesis Testing and Nonparametric Methods
curriculum_locator: Stat H-301 Hypothesis Testing and Nonparametric Methods; University of Dhaka four-year B.S. Honours Statistics curriculum, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Architecture of Statistical Hypothesis Testing: Neyman-Pearson Paradigm, Power Functions & P-Values
scope: Simple and composite statistical hypotheses, parameter space partitions, and critical versus acceptance regions
Non-randomized and randomized test functions phi(x), Type I error probability alpha(theta), and Type II error beta(theta)
Test size, significance level alpha, power function beta(theta) = E_theta[phi(X)], and operating characteristic curves
Duality between (1 - alpha) confidence sets and size-alpha hypothesis tests; uniformly most accurate confidence bounds
Mathematical properties of p-values: probability integral transform under H_0, discrete randomization, and multiple testing (Bonferroni & Benjamini-Hochberg FDR)

units.title: Most Powerful Tests, the Neyman-Pearson Fundamental Lemma & Monotone Likelihood Ratio Families
scope: Simple-versus-simple hypothesis testing and the Neyman-Pearson Fundamental Lemma (existence, uniqueness, and sufficiency)
Randomized Neyman-Pearson tests for discrete distributions (Binomial, Poisson, Hypergeometric) to achieve exact size alpha
Strict unbiasedness of Most Powerful (MP) tests: proof that power under H_1 strictly exceeds size alpha
One-parameter exponential families and families with Monotone Likelihood Ratio (MLR)
Karlin-Rubin Theorem for Uniformly Most Powerful (UMP) one-sided tests and non-existence of two-sided UMP tests

units.title: Uniformly Most Powerful Unbiased (UMPU) Tests, Similar Regions & Invariance Principles
scope: Unbiased hypothesis tests, alpha-similar boundary conditions, and Neyman structure with respect to complete sufficient statistics
Two-sided UMPU tests in one-parameter exponential families: dual critical values and equal-tail approximations
Multiparameter exponential families with nuisance parameters: conditional UMPU tests (Student's t, Fisher's exact test, Poisson ratio)
Group invariance in hypothesis testing: maximal invariants, location-scale transformations, and Uniformly Most Powerful Invariant (UMPI) tests
Pitman asymptotic relative efficiency (ARE) and Bahadur efficiency of competing test sequences

units.title: Generalized Likelihood Ratio Tests (GLRT), Wilks' Theorem & the Asymptotic Trinity
scope: Generalized Likelihood Ratio statistic Lambda(x) for composite hypotheses with nuisance parameters
Exact finite-sample GLRT derivations for Normal linear models: one-sample t, two-sample pooled t, Welch-Satterthwaite, and variance F-tests
Bartlett's test for homogeneity of k variances and Box's M-approximation
Wilks' Theorem: Taylor expansion of log-likelihood and asymptotic chi-square distribution of -2 ln Lambda(X)
The Asymptotic Trinity: Wald, Rao Score (Lagrange Multiplier), and Likelihood Ratio test equivalence under local Pitman alternatives

units.title: Sequential Hypothesis Testing: Wald's SPRT, Stopping Boundaries, OC & ASN Functions
scope: Sequential sampling versus fixed-sample Neyman-Pearson designs and Abraham Wald's Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT)
Fundamental stopping inequalities and Wald's boundary approximations A approx (1 - beta)/alpha and B approx beta/(1 - alpha)
Proof of finite termination with probability one (P(N < infinity) = 1) via Stein's Lemma
Wald's Fundamental Identity E[exp(t Z_N) (M(t))^(-N)] = 1 and Operating Characteristic (OC) curve L(theta) derivation
Average Sample Number (ASN) E_theta[N] for Bernoulli, Poisson, Normal, and Exponential sequential tests

units.title: Goodness-of-Fit & Empirical Distribution Tests: Chi-Square, Kolmogorov-Smirnov & Lilliefors
scope: Karl Pearson's Chi-Square goodness-of-fit test, multinomial cell asymptotics, and Fisher's theorem on degrees of freedom reduction for estimated parameters
Contingency table tests of independence and homogeneity, Yates' continuity correction, and Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel stratified tests
Empirical Distribution Function (EDF) F_n(x), Glivenko-Cantelli Theorem, and Donsker's Brownian bridge convergence
One-sample and two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) supremum statistics (D_n, D_n^+, D_n^-) and exact Smirnov recursions
Cramér-von Mises, Anderson-Darling tail-weighted statistics, Lilliefors normality correction, and Shapiro-Wilk W test

units.title: Nonparametric One-Sample & Two-Sample Rank Tests: Sign, Wilcoxon, Mann-Whitney & Scale Tests
scope: Distribution-free statistics, order statistics, rank invariance under monotone transformations, and exact combinatorial null distributions
One-sample and paired-sample Sign Test and Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test (T^+): exact recursion, moments, tie corrections, and Walsh averages (Hodges-Lehmann estimator)
Two-sample location problem: Wilcoxon Rank-Sum Test and Mann-Whitney U statistic; equivalence U = W - n_1(n_1+1)/2 and P(X < Y) stochastic dominance
General linear rank statistics, normal scores (van der Waerden and Terry-Hoeffding), and Pitman ARE of Wilcoxon vs Student's t (3/pi approx 0.955 under normality)
Nonparametric tests for randomness (Wald-Wolfowitz runs test) and two-sample scale dispersion (Ansari-Bradley, Mood, and Siegel-Tukey tests)

units.title: Multi-Sample Nonparametrics, Rank Correlation & Resampling: Kruskal-Wallis, Friedman, Kendall & Permutation
scope: One-way nonparametric ANOVA: Kruskal-Wallis H statistic, exact permutation distribution, tie adjustments, Chi-square asymptotics, and Dunn's post-hoc comparisons
Randomized complete block designs: Friedman's two-way analysis of variance by ranks, Kendall's Coefficient of Concordance W, and Cochran's Q test for binary responses
Ordered alternatives in multi-sample designs: Jonckheere-Terpstra test and Page's L test for monotonic trends
Nonparametric measures of association: Spearman's rho, Kendall's tau (concordant/discordant pairs and U-statistic variance), and Goodman-Kruskal gamma
Exact Fisher-Pitman permutation tests, exchangeability under H_0, Monte Carlo randomization p-values, and bootstrap hypothesis testing
